content:
Doing the same thing over and over again and expecting different results is the definition of insanity.

It also appears to be the Republican midterm message to voters.

Seriously.

Political analysts point to current data showing a potential "blue wave" that could hand the House back to Democrats, driven in part by historically low approval ratings for Donald Trump.

Republicans appear headed for significant losses in House races unless the party can craft a message to convince voters to keep them in power.

House Speaker Mike Johnson had a chance to make the case to voters during an interview on CNBC's "Squawk Box" on Tuesday — and ended up doing the Democrats a huge favor.

"What we're going to do for the next two years is exactly what we've been doing, which is setting the table for a strong America," Johnson said.

He elaborated:

Johnson tried to win hearts and minds by promising to continue the very policies that have led to a war with Iran, higher gas prices and inflation — and it backfired spectacularly.

In fact, it landed just as badly as Vice President JD Vance's plea earlier this month for voters to "give us another chance."
